description: Source file implementing the Packager functionality for software updates, including configuration, installation, repository synchronization, and plugin management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Class managing software packaging, installation, configuration, and plugin lifecycle within the WPEFramework plugin system.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the global opkg configuration based on current class settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the packager with provided service parameters, setting paths, verbosity, and other options.

methods.name: ~PackagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and releasing references.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for package events.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package by name, version, and architecture.

methods.name: DoWork
methods.description: Performs installation or synchronization work based on provided package info.

methods.name: BlockingInstallUntilCompletionNoLock
methods.description: Performs a blocking installation of the current package, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: GetMetadataFile
methods.description: Constructs the path to the package's metadata JSON file.

methods.name: GetCallsign
methods.description: Reads package metadata to extract the callsign if the package is a plugin.

methods.name: GetInstallationPath
methods.description: Returns the installation path for a given application name.

methods.name: UpdateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates plugin configuration with the plugin's callsign and installation path.

methods.name: DeactivatePlugin
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin by callsign and updates its configuration.

methods.name: NotifyStateChange
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of a change in package installation state.

methods.name: NotifyRepoSynced
methods.description: Notifies observers that repository synchronization has completed.

methods.name: InitOPKG
methods.description: Initializes the opkg system with current configuration.

methods.name: FreeOPKG
methods.description: Cleans up and deinitializes the opkg system.

methods.name: BlockingSetupLocalRepoNoLock
methods.description: Sets up local repository, optionally updating package lists.
